simulation_brief.decision_rule: official negotiated text must include explicit binding commitment or roadmap for fossil-fuel phaseout to realize yes-like endpoint
simulation_brief.summary: COP30 opens in Belém with pressure for explicit fossil-fuel phaseout language in the final official negotiated text. A sizable pro-phaseout coalition faces resistance from oil- and gas-producing states under consensus-style blocking dynamics. Adjacent bargaining issues include adaptation finance, just transition, and implementation indicators. T0 uncertainty centers on whether binding phaseout language can survive dilution into official consensus text rather than side declarations or voluntary remarks.
